# fix: drop redundant non-null assertions on ResultN.okay

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

## Summary
- `ResultN<Ok, Err>.okay` is non-nullable — the `!` suffix tripped AS210 (\"Expression is never 'null'\") on every build
- Removed the redundant `!` in the three remaining call sites: `examples/library/assembly/refine.ts`, `sdk/jam/refine/nested-pvm.ts` (`NestedPvm.fromSpi` panicking wrapper), and the 11 `Machine.create(...).okay!` sites in `sdk/jam/machine.test.ts`
- Swept the repo via `asc` builds against SDK tests + every example — no AS210 warnings remain

## Test plan
- [x] `npm run asbuild:test` in `sdk/` is clean
- [x] `npm run asbuild` in every `examples/*/` is clean
- [x] `npm test` (full workspace) — all suites pass
